h1: Simple dashboards for sales, products and marketing
overview: We connect your store, analytics and ad accounts to one dashboard, usually in Looker Studio, so you open a single page to see how the business is doing. We choose charts with you, such as revenue, orders, top products, ad spend and conversion rate, label them in plain words and make sure the numbers match your sources. The dashboard updates on its own and can be shared with your team.

faq: Which tool do you build dashboards in?

Looker Studio is our default because it is free and connects to Google Analytics, Google Ads and Sheets. We can also build in Power BI or a shared spreadsheet if you prefer, which we confirm before starting.
Can the dashboard include Shopify or WooCommerce sales?
Yes. We connect through a free or low-cost connector or a daily export to Google Sheets. Any monthly connector fee is paid by you, and we name the options and costs before choosing.
Will the numbers match my store reports?
We compare each figure to the source and note small differences, such as time zones or refund timing. Matching to the cent is not always possible, and we explain every gap we find.
Only people you invite. You own the dashboard and the connections, so you can add or remove viewers at any time. We keep editor access only while we work.
